task: Align frontend retry handling with API idempotency processing response
findings: Frontend already sends a stable Idempotency-Key for event checkout and reuses it across transient retries.
API middleware returns HTTP 425 with Idempotency-Status=processing while an identical request is still executing.
Frontend isIdempotencyProcessing currently recognizes only HTTP 409, so a legitimate concurrent/replayed checkout can surface as an error instead of waiting and replaying safely.
Mercado Pago provider payment creation already uses an order-derived idempotency key; fulfillment counts existing EventPass rows before issuing missing passes.

implementation.change: Treat both 409 and 425 with Idempotency-Status=processing as bounded retryable idempotency responses.
implementation.test: CommerceService.transientRetry.test.js: 7/7 passed, including new HTTP 425 processing retry regression test.
